premise: Bear cub has the hiccups; Frog's big cures fail, and tiny Mouse's lullaby makes him yawn them away.
inspiration: The Lion and the Mouse (Aesop), turned: the smallest helps the biggest, not with strength but with a whisper.
lesson: Sometimes the gentlest help works best.

en-US.title: Bear Cub Has the Hiccups
en-US.text: {sfx:hic} Hic! The {bear:enter} bear cub had the hiccups. {bear:face surprised} {bear:wobble} Hic! [giggles] Hold your breath! said {frog:enter} Frog, hopping up. The bear cub held his breath {bear:shake 0.4} until his cheeks were round. Hic! {frog:hop} Jump up and down! said Frog. The bear cub bounced {bear:hop x3} until the ground shook. {sfx:hic} HIC! {bear:face sad} [sighs] Nothing worked. Then little {mouse:enter} Mouse scampered up. {mouse:face happy} Let me see. {mouse:live} He sniffed the air, whiskers twitching, rose on tiptoe to look and listen… then dropped down and washed his face. [whispers] I know, he said. And he sang the softest lullaby: [sings] la, la, lulla-by… {bear:face normal} {bear:live hold} The bear cub yawned, stretched up high, rubbed his eyes… and nodded off. [whispers] Frog and Mouse waited. One. Two. Three. {frog:face surprised} No hiccups! {mouse:sparkle} [happily] Mouse and Frog {frog:hearts} {mouse:go away} {frog:go away} tiptoed away, and the bear cub slept, hiccup-free, all afternoon.

es-ES.title: El osito tiene hipo
es-ES.text: {sfx:hic} ¡Hip! El {bear:enter} osito tenía hipo. {bear:face surprised} {bear:wobble} ¡Hip! [giggles] ¡Aguanta la respiración!, dijo {frog:enter} Rana, llegando a saltos. El osito aguantó {bear:shake 0.4} hasta que se le pusieron los mofletes redondos. ¡Hip! {frog:hop} ¡Salta arriba y abajo!, dijo Rana. El osito dio botes {bear:hop x3} hasta que tembló el suelo. {sfx:hic} ¡HIP! {bear:face sad} [sighs] Nada funcionaba. Entonces llegó correteando el pequeño {mouse:enter} Ratón. {mouse:face happy} A ver… {mouse:live} Olfateó el aire, moviendo los bigotes, se puso de puntillas para mirar y escuchar… luego bajó y se lavó la cara. [whispers] Ya sé, dijo. Y le cantó la nana más suave: [sings] la, la, a la nanita… {bear:face normal} {bear:live hold} El osito bostezó, se estiró, se frotó los ojos… y se quedó dormido. [whispers] Rana y Ratón esperaron. Uno. Dos. Tres. {frog:face surprised} ¡Ni un hipo! {mouse:sparkle} [happily] Ratón y Rana {frog:hearts} {mouse:go away} {frog:go away} se fueron de puntillas, y el osito durmió sin hipo toda la tarde.
